data.title: Grant to Cancer Research UK
data.description: As directed by the donor towards Cancer Research UK's work to prevent, control and cure cancer through ground-breaking research.

recipientOrganization.name: Cancer Research UK
recipientOrganization.description: Cancer Research UK is the world's leading charity dedicated to beating cancer through research. Their groundbreaking work into the prevention, diagnosis and treatment of cancer has saved millions of lives. Survival rates have doubled in the last thirty years and they have been at the heart of the progress. But on in three of us will still get cancer at some point and their vital work, funded entirely by the public, will help ensure that milliions more people will survive.
